study_title: Forecast Maturity of Technical Performance Margin on NASA Li-ion Battery Aging Data
design: Secondary fixed-checkpoint prognostics analysis of four laboratory battery aging trajectories
canonical_source: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence Battery Data Set
eol_definition: 30% fade in rated capacity, from 2.0 Ah to 1.4 Ah
rebuild_policy: Official NASA archive only. Nested ZIPs are recursively expanded and MATLAB files are parsed directly. No synthetic fallback.
scientific_correction: The prototype's first-60%-of-final-history split was horizon-dependent. The released protocol uses fixed checkpoints 40, 60, and 80 for every cell.

interpretation_notes.tpm_framing: Capacity is used as a laboratory performance parameter in a TPM-style monitoring case study, not as a complete system-level TPM.
interpretation_notes.forecast_revision: Forecast revision is a descriptive stability measure and is not calibrated uncertainty.
interpretation_notes.b0007: No 1.4 Ah crossing is observed through cycle 168; a projected crossing within that horizon is treated as a false early warning.

claim_boundary: Transparent descriptive baseline on four NASA laboratory cells. Results are not evidence of production readiness, calibrated RUL uncertainty, state-of-the-art prognostics performance, or cross-cell and cross-chemistry generalization.
